subject: Two weeks out
preview_text: Something I've been building quietly. Figured you should hear it first.
body_html:
Hey,

Been a minute. I'll keep this short.

In two weeks I'm dropping a book called AI for Traders & Creators.

It's the stuff I wish someone handed me three years ago. How I use AI to run trades, build content, and pull income while I sleep. No theory. No guru nonsense. Just what works and what doesn't.

Why am I telling you now? Because people on this list get first access. Early pricing. Bonus material that won't exist after launch week.

You don't need to do anything yet. Just watch your inbox. I'll send one more note before it goes live.

If this isn't your thing anymore, unsubscribe. No hard feelings.

If it is — buckle up.

— Jhon
